description: Planned 80-image pilot, not execution evidence: 4 prompts x 4 seeds x 5 conditions. Original/off is an image-only native-path control; spectral coverage is unavailable for it. Dry-run is the runner default; no auto-submission.

design.model_identity: Set all three loader names explicitly for the approved hardware/model; freeze hashes separately.
design.interpretation: Exploratory pilot. Same-call preservation does not guarantee invariant final composition. Preserve-minus-manual-zero spectral contrast is separate from blinded image ratings.
